create_image_processor: create a MiniCPMV4_6ImageProcessor instance to preprocess images for the MiniCPM-V4.6 vision-language model
preprocess_images: preprocess a list of images into pixel_values and target_sizes tensors using the MiniCPMV4_6ImageProcessor
find_best_resize: calculate the optimal resize dimensions for an image based on scale resolution and patch size
get_sliced_grid: determine the best grid layout for slicing high-resolution images into multiple patches
reshape_by_patch: reshape a tensor into NaViT patchified format using the reshape_by_patch method
